settings.title: Make every gift feel part of the same event.
settings.text: Member-guest gifts should repeat one accent so the table, carts, and bags feel coordinated.

settings.title: Choose useful pieces over novelty.
settings.text: Towels, tools, markers, and desk pieces are safer than one-off novelty gifts.

settings.title: Build prize tiers by use.
settings.text: Small tier: markers. Mid tier: towels. Premium tier: coordinated kit or desk bundle.

settings.title: Pick the event accent
settings.text: Use club, sponsor, or tournament color as the shared accent.

settings.title: Choose a safe base
settings.text: Black, white, navy, and green are the safest group-gift colors.

settings.title: Repeat the system
settings.text: Every gift tier should look related even when the items differ.

settings.heading: Golf gifts that look event-ready.
settings.subheading: A member-guest gifting path for prize tables, tee gifts, team bags, and sponsor-ready accessories.
